The files will be read by the Gemini model when generating a response. The contents of the text file count toward the token limit. 🛈 TIP: Can be chained together with other Gemini Input File nodes.', inputs=[IO.Combo.Input('file', options=input_files, default=input_files[0] if input_files else None, tooltip='Input files to include as context for the model. Used for adjusting guide processing as required by certain IC-LoRAs (eg. those with a reference_downscale_factor > 1). When chained, each LTXVAddGuide uses only the parameters connected to it.')], outputs=[io.Conditioning.Output(display_name='positive'), io.Conditioning.Output(display_name='negative'), io.Latent.Output(display_name='latent')])
